definitions.gloss: producing in succession; turning out (talented people)
definitions.explanation: The continuous production of notable or talented individuals from a school, region, or organization. Always refers to people, not things.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学者|がくしゃ}→学者：02544_gakusha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{輩出|はいしゅつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This university has produced many scholars.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧{輩出|はいしゅつ}してきた。
examples.english: That region has produced many politicians over the years.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{輩出|はいしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This high school is known throughout the country for producing Olympic athletes.

notes:
{輩出|はいしゅつ} is a noun that can function as a suru verb ({輩出|はいしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). It is exclusively used for producing people of talent or distinction, not for objects or products.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [person type]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{輩出|はいしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (produce/turn out people of a type)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{輩出|はいしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (produce talented people)
- ⟦{学者|がくしゃ}→学者：02544_gakusha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{輩出|はいしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (produce scholars)
- ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{輩出|はいしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (produce athletes)

The subject is always an institution, organization, region, or era — something that serves as a source or training ground for people. The word carries a positive connotation, implying pride in the succession of talented individuals.
